question: 연령대별 전립선암 환자 수를 알려줘
intent: count patients grouped by age band
sql: SELECT age_10_sect_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) AS patient_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info GROUP BY age_10_sect_nm ORDER BY age_10_sect_nm

question: Gleason Grade Group별 검사 건수를 보여줘
intent: count pathology exams grouped by gleason grade group
sql: SELECT grade_group, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_path GROUP BY grade_group ORDER BY exam_count DESC

question: 2023년 이후 로봇 수술을 받은 전립선암 환자 수를 Gleason 위험군별로 알려줘
sql:
SELECT
  ppath.grade_group AS gleason_risk_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pop.s_patno) AS patient_count
FROM
  poc.poc_prostate_op pop
JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_path ppath ON pop.s_patno = ppath.s_patno
    AND TO_DATE(ppath.rslt_cnfm_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD')
LEFT JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_patient_info ppinfo ON pop.s_patno = ppinfo.s_patno
WHERE
  pop.op_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND pop.inhosp_op_eng_nm IN ('Robotic Radical Prostatectomy (da Vinci)', 'Robot-assisted Radical Prostatectomy', 'Robot-assisted Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy')
GROUP BY
  ppath.grade_group
ORDER BY
  patient_count DESC
LIMIT 100
sql_before_edit:
SELECT
  ppath.grade_group AS gleason_risk_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pop.s_patno) AS patient_count
FROM
  poc.poc_prostate_op pop
JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_path ppath ON pop.s_patno = ppath.s_patno
    AND TO_DATE(ppath.rslt_cnfm_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD')
LEFT JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_patient_info ppinfo ON pop.s_patno = ppinfo.s_patno
WHERE
  pop.op_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND pop.inhosp_op_eng_nm ILIKE '%robot%'
GROUP BY
  ppath.grade_group
ORDER BY
  patient_count DESC
LIMIT 100
correction_reason: 로봇 수술 여부는 ILIKE '%robot%'이 아니라 inhosp_op_eng_nm의 실제 값(Robotic/Robot-assisted 계열)을 IN절로 명시해야 함
